style: Gouache and paper collage with story-sequence diagrams
provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
note: Pictures support the lesson text and do not replace decoding or evidence from narration. Key lesson word-part examples have native editable labels; other schematic marks illustrate organization. Read sort statements in their supplied context. Educator review is pending.

sources.prompt: Square text-free children story illustration in soft gouache and paper collage. A small golden puppy with floppy ears has just arrived at a home doorway, sitting beside a plain teal pet bed. Warm daytime entryway, clear puppy subject, no people, no text, no numbers. Stylized, not photorealistic; this is the beginning of a story.
sources.alt: A golden puppy sits inside a home doorway beside a teal pet bed.
sources.caption: Beginning of Ada’s invented story: a new puppy arrives. Use the text to establish Ada and the setting; the illustration adds an imagined doorway and bed.

sources.prompt: Square text-free children story illustration in soft gouache and paper collage. A small golden puppy with floppy ears lies on an ivory floor chewing its own sturdy teal knotted rope toy. A pair of purple shoes rests safely up on a shelf in the background. Clear toy and puppy as the main focus. No people, no text, no numbers. Stylized, not photorealistic; scene illustrates the ending of an invented puppy story.
sources.alt: A golden puppy chews a teal rope toy while purple shoes rest on a shelf.
sources.caption: Ending of the invented story: the puppy chews its own rope toy. This solves the chewing problem within the story, not a promise about real puppy training.
